about: Shared outcome-kinds corpus (board task_1791419247017_jri7): holoscript validate (validateCanonicalSource) and the deterministic headless runtime admission must reach the same verdict on every file. valid=false files name the diagnostic codes the checker reports; v06 is valid with a warning.

v01-declared-decisions.hsplus.why: every decision action declares its outcomes; every answer matches; refusals come before any change

v02-lists-on-own-lines.hsplus.why: outcome lists may sit on their own lines and in either order

v03-accepted-may-change-nothing.hsplus.why: an accepted outcome may change state, but does not have to

v04-change-on-branch-that-answers-accept.why: a change inside a branch that always answers accepted does not reach the refusal after it

v05-no-declarations.hsplus.why: a program that declares no outcomes is read exactly as before

v06-declared-outcome-never-answered.hspl.why: a declared outcome that is never answered is a warning, not a failure

v07-choice-between-names.hsplus.why: an outcome written as a choice between quoted names is checked as every name it can be

i01-refused-after-state-change.hsplus.why: the refused outcome bad_hours is answered after the action already took a bike back

i02-refused-after-announcement.hsplus.why: the refused outcome blocked is answered after the action already announced pinged

i03-refused-after-possible-change.hsplus.why: a branch that may change state falls through to a refusal

i04-undeclared-outcome.hsplus.why: the action answers too_many, which it does not declare

i05-wrong-kind.hsplus.why: fine_unpaid is declared refused but answered with allowed: true

i06-outcome-not-checkable.hsplus.why: the outcome is taken from an input, so it cannot be checked against the declaration (and the declared outcome is never written as an answer)

i07-partial-declaration.hsplus.why: one decision action declares its outcomes and another decision action does not

i08-outcome-listed-twice.hsplus.why: the same outcome name is listed twice

i09-outcome-both-kinds.hsplus.why: one outcome is listed as both accepted and refused
